title: Elucidating the Molecular and Biochemical Basis of the Human AhR-mutation Disease
brief_summary: In a previous study, we have identified a consanguineous family from Northern Israel with three children affected by idiopathic infantile nystagmus (IIN) and foveal hypoplasia, which follow an autosomal recessive mode of inheritance of AhR gene. in this study we will determine whether the disease phenotype is the consequence of a decrease in or absence of AHR-induced AHH activity
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with mutation in AhR gene

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
